decisions.reason: A cutting and creasing finisher close to the core distributed portfolio costs little to list, and two years have not yet resolved its uncertainty enough to justify abandoning the option.
The UV spot varnishing system is a distant, higher-cost option whose value is still unclear, but as a recently premiered flagship it warrants staying open a while longer before any abandonment.
The sheet preparation module is a cheap complementary add-on to established systems with no negative signal, so keeping the option open remains sensible.
The B2 multifinisher is a core-aligned flagship supporting the automation direction, which justifies continued commitment rather than abandonment.
The hybrid saddle stitcher fits the core booklet-making business at low holding cost, and its uncertain value still merits keeping the option.
The folding add-on has a documented inline customer installation, a positive resolution of uncertainty at little cost, so it stays on the market.
